gbm_population_evidence.quote: Patients with advanced malignant glioma confirmed by histopathology;

candidate_evidence.quote: [DRUG] Recombinant NV-A01 adenovirus injection: Patients with advanced glioblastoma were intratumoral injected with NV-A01.

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Patients who have received radiotherapy and/or temozolomide (TMZ) treatment and have residual or recurrent tumors;

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: Proportion of CD3+, CD4+, CD8+T cells and the expression of CD69 on the surface of T cells in peripheral blood are detected by flow cytometry.

agents.drug_class_hint: recombinant adenovirus (gene therapy / oncolytic virus type), intratumoral

coder_notes: Eligibility says advanced malignant glioma; glioblastoma is named in conditions and the summary, so coded mixed_glioma_gbm_named (gbm_only is an alternative since the conditions field lists only glioblastoma). NV-A01 is a recombinant adenovirus, so it is an excluded intervention type (gene therapy / oncolytic virus); the record does not state which. Blood immune markers are planned as pharmacodynamic indicators.
